channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Here's the inflation breakdown for September 2026 — in one chart
item.description: The consumer price index rose by 3.7% in September, on the back of higher gasoline and energy prices largely due to the Iran war.

item.title: Netflix to lay off roughly 1,000 employees, or 6% of workforce
item.description: Netflix will lay off roughly 6% of its workforce, according to a memo obtained by CNBC.

item.title: Social Security Administration announces 3.6% cost-of-living adjustment for 2027
item.description: With a 3.6% COLA for 2027, Social Security retirement benefit checks will go up by $75 per month, on average, the agency said.

item.title: Bank of America shares drop 8% after third-quarter revenue miss and regulatory penalty
item.description: Bank of America shares fell Wednesday after the company posted weaker-than-expected trading revenue and the impact of a $1.2 billion Treasury fine.

item.title: Iran says it’s ‘counting the moments’ until it can strike U.S. warships; Saudi Aramco facilities attacked
item.description: Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia's Aramco reportedly came under fresh attack overnight.

item.title: This struggling denim stock is bound to bounce back, Jefferies says
item.description: Kontoor Brands is likely to see its shares rise considerably amid growing interest in denim among consumers, per Jefferies.

item.title: Bending Spoons skyrockets 35% as Berkshire Hathaway makes $330 million investment
item.description: Berkshire's latest investment follows the $600 million it invested in the company's IPO this July.

item.title: 10-year Treasury yield jumps as September core inflation comes in hotter than expected
item.description: Treasury yields moved higher after the latest inflation reading.

item.title: Delta's business-class revamp: New seats, menus, plates and more Porsches
item.description: Delta is upgrading its top-tier Delta One cabin with new suites for its largest A350 plane, starting next year.

item.title: Morgan Stanley tops estimates as equities trading revenue beats expectations by $909 million
item.description: Morgan Stanley topped expectations on the top and bottom lines for the third quarter.

item.title: Trump's diesel dilemma — by the numbers
item.description: Conflicts in Ukraine and Iran have created major ripple effects across global energy markets causing major price swings.

item.title: South Texas Latino voters who flipped for Trump in 2024 are up for grabs in 2026
item.description: Hispanic and Latino voters swung hard for President Donald Trump in 2024. But in the 2026 midterm election, Democrats are pushing to get them back.

item.title: Tech giants race to get AI gadgets on shelves for holiday rush
item.description: With the holidays just a couple months away, tech companies are betting this is finally the year that AI gadgets make the shopping list.

item.title: FBI arrests Saudi OpenAI employee who allegedly planted recording device in conference room
item.description: The Tuesday incident comes as the ChatGPT-maker, along with competitors, faces heightened scrutiny over its safety practices.

item.title: A second major Wall Street bank this week is telling clients to cash in tech stocks. Here's why
item.description: Multiple banks are now expecting a down leg for the tech trade, which could broaden out performance in a healthy way.

item.title: Ukraine warns Starlink limits are disrupting military operations as Russia pounds its energy infrastructure
item.description: A ballistic missile has struck energy infrastructure supposedly covered by the "energy ceasefire" announced by Trump on Sunday, Zelenskyy said.

item.title: How Trump’s tariffs and Iran war are becoming liabilities in Michigan’s Senate race
item.description: Republicans are largely leaving Trump out of general election ads, with some battleground candidates breaking from him on tariffs and Iran.

item.title: Don't let inflation bite — how to hedge with TIPS, commodities and infrastructure funds
item.description: TIPS are looking attractive but they aren't the only way to get inflation protection.

item.title: ASML says it's getting order interest through 2030 as profit smashes expectations
item.description: ASML said some customers are "expressing an interest" in placing orders with the company in 2029 and 2030, giving investors a view into longer-term demand.

item.title: 'Office' is actually having a scarcity problem
item.description: The U.S. office market is roaring back to health but its speedy recovery is resulting in a shortage, especially of premium space.

item.title: Jim Cramer's top 10 things to watch in the stock market Wednesday
item.description: The Septembr CPI report came in hot, and Morgan Stanley's equities trading blew past expectations.

item.title: CNBC Points Pro: How to book a flight to South Africa with points
item.description: Points expert Jason Stauffer explains how to use points and miles to fly from New York City to South Africa.

item.title: BlackRock draws $205 billion in client funds as quarterly profit beats estimates
item.description: BlackRock's assets under management — which determine a large chunk of its earnings — rose to $15.49 trillion, from $13.46 trillion a year earlier.

item.title: Oil prices rise after IEA warns on market constraints; Saudi officials say Aramco facilities attacked
item.description: Worries over supply disruptions due to escalating tensions in the Middle East helped to push oil prices higher.

item.title: Even more borrowers choose riskier mortgages, as higher interest rates crush affordability
item.description: Interest rates on mortgages continue to rise, leaving some buyers to choose riskier, adjustable-rate mortgages to find savings.

item.title: Scott Bessent's growth plans aren't enough to tame surging deficit and debt pile, IMF chief says
item.description: IMF chief Kristalina Georgieva said Bessent’s reliance on growth won’t cut the U.S. deficit and $40 trillion debt fast enough, calling for fiscal consolidation.

item.title: JPMorgan Chase blocks outside AI agents like Muse, Instinct from directly accessing accounts
item.description: JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon warned of rogue agents operating at scale and said the bank is building defensive tools.

item.title: Judge says Musk engaged in intimidation of ex-FEMA CFO Mary Comans, clears her name
item.description: Ex-FEMA CFO Mary Comans' name was cleared by a federal judge after Elon Musk and other government officials falsely accused her of criminal actions in 2025.

item.title: Williams says Fed may not have to hike rates in 2027, at odds with traders
item.description: New York Fed President John Williams sees one more rate hike in 2026 but no additional increase in 2027 as inflation pressures ease.

item.title: Michael Dell says AI needs safeguards and controls, and government has a role to play
item.description: Dell CEO Michael Dell says AI models need safeguards and controls, with companies and government both playing a role in safety.
